title: Source-bound irrigation rate adaptation and duration

source.units: irr_depth in cm; irr_rate in cm/day after read-time conversion; dt_irr_event in days.
source.equation: If rate>0 and depth/rate>1, use rate=depth and duration=1; otherwise if rate>0 use rate unchanged and duration=depth/rate; if rate<=0 use rate=depth and duration=1. The selected rate is assigned to gird for isua<2 or uniformly to each selected SSDI node when isua>=2.

scope: pure legacy rate adaptation and event-duration materialization
surface rate or per-node SSDI rate assignment and summed selected rate
zero-rate spread, exact one-day equality and over-one-day adaptation boundaries
100000 deterministic equation comparisons at O0/O2 with identical transcripts
non_goals: irrigation depth or selector derivation, event calendar, interval splitting or process invocation
claim that summing SSDI node source rates is the whole-column external water amount
accepted source booking, solute, transaction, restart or production admission
pass_conditions: selected rate and duration follow exact B1.11 branch ordering and strict >1 day test
surface scalar and SSDI repeated-node assignment match the source branch
each deterministic vector matches the independent source-form oracle
